description: This file defines the MyAttendanceRecordAPI class, which extends EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI and provides API methods related to employee attendance records, including validation and punch time extraction.

classes.name: MyAttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee attendance records, including validation and punch time extraction.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for fetching all attendance records, removing employee number validation.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Converts a dateTime string into a DateTime object considering timezone offset, with validation.

methods.name: isCurrantDateTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided dateTime is within 180 seconds of the current system time in the user's timezone.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchInActions
methods.description: Checks if punch-in actions are allowed based on allowed actions array.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchOutActions
methods.description: Checks if punch-out actions are allowed based on allowed actions array.
